question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**dozed off'** means to fall into a light sleep, often unintentionally. (झपकी लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **He **dozed off **during the boring lecture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5 is **'dozed off'**.

Therefore, the correct statement is ' the clock struck three and I ***dozed off ***to sleep.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **called off **(रद्द करना): To cancel an event or activity.

 
 
• **Example:** The football match was ***called off*** due to rain.
 
• **Example **: The meeting was*** called off ***due to unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• **took off **(उड़ान भरना): To leave the ground and begin to fly.
 
 
• **Example: **The airplane ***took off ***smoothly despite the bad weather.
 
 
 
• **put off** (टालना): To delay or postpone something.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to ***put off*** her vacation until next year
